title: Before is not an instruction to enter
origin: New teaching pair; not the historical JSON template or an experimental outcome.
source: Approach the reading room but bear left before entering it and continue into the lobby.

subtasks: Approach the reading room but bear left before entering it and continue into the lobby.
Approach the reading room and enter it. Then bear left and continue into the lobby.

execution_or_focus_difference: The candidate crosses the threshold before the turn. No threshold stop is entailed either.
alternative_or_limit: One coupled maneuver is preferable; do not split off an unbounded approach.
